Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Single-Light Domed Metal Pendant Light, 63"H, Soft Matte Gray
Colors: Soft Gray
Materials: Metal
This matte gray pendant light adds subtle interest to any space without clashing with existing color schemes. The dome shape lends contemporary flair to any room in your home, and the long cord provides versatility, allowing you to easily move light to the areas that need it most. 10"W x 10"D x 63"H Metal shade in a matte finish The industrial style and long cord provide style and function, making this lamp perfect in kitchens, bar areas, or wherever you need a versatile light. 1 60-watt E26 bulb required. Bulb not included. Assemble in 15-30 minutes For indoor use only.
